action_args.justification: The series has a dominant upward trend (strength 0.97) and strong 12-month seasonality (0.73), with moderate ranking stability (Kendall tau 0.478). The trimmed_mean over the 5 most consistently-ranked models (CWT_rf, FT_rf, CWT_catboost, DWT_catboost, ONLY_CWT_rf) already captures the best of each correlated-error group while trimming the weakest contributor. The runner-up (trimmed_mean pool3) is statistically indistinguishable, and the weighted approach (w1) performed worst, confirming that robust averaging over a tight, stable subset is the right combination kind for this series.
